data.situation:
By the second Saturday, repair requests were arriving steadily. Jay separated the quick jobs from the ones that needed a new part. He had not foreseen how long a damaged zip could take. Mina looked at the rota, then at the bags waiting under the bench. Finishing all of them by six was virtually impossible. It had been a taxing morning, and neither of them wanted to promise something they could not do. They moved one collection date to Tuesday and called the customer before changing the card. The eventual result was a quieter bench and a shorter queue. Noor drew a line across the rota at lunchtime. There would be a real break between the morning and afternoon shifts. SATURDAY — REVISED REPAIR ROTA
10:00–12:30: handles and simple seams.
12:30–1:00: lunch; no bench work.
1:00–4:30: zips and repairs awaiting parts.
Collections: check the date on each card. Call the customer if the date must change.

It had been a taxing morning, and neither of them wanted to promise something they could not do. They moved one collection date to Tuesday and called the customer before changing the card. readingBlocks.zh: 到第二个周六，维修要求持续到来。杰伊把快修的活和需要新零件的活分开。他没预见到一个坏拉链会花那么久。米娜看了排班表，又看工作台下等着的包。六点前全部完成几乎不可能。这是个累人的上午，两人都不想许下做不到的承诺。他们把一个取件日期改到周二，并在修改卡片前给顾客打了电话。最后工作台没那么拥挤，队伍也短了些。努尔在排班表的午饭时间画了一条线，早班和午班之间会有一次真正的休息。

10:00–12:30: handles and simple seams.
12:30–1:00: lunch; no bench work.
1:00–4:30: zips and repairs awaiting parts.
Collections: check the date on each card. Call the customer if the date must change.
readingBlocks.zh:
周六——修改后的维修排班表
10:00–12:30：提手和简单接缝。
12:30–1:00：午饭；暂停工作台维修。
1:00–4:30：拉链及等待零件的维修。
取件：查看每张卡上的日期。日期必须修改时，给顾客打电话。

glossary.note: steadily 描述连续而相对稳定的过程；不意味数量永不变化。

externalEvidence.definition: at a steady rate or pace

glossary.note: separate A from B；来源为动词，不用形容词 separate 的读音。
glossary.example: Jay separated quick jobs from longer repairs.
glossary.exampleZh: 杰伊把快修和费时的维修分开。

glossary.zh: 预见将来可能发生的事情
glossary.note: foresee a problem；过去式 foresaw，过去分词 foreseen。
glossary.example: Jay had not foreseen the delay.

glossary.zh: 经过一段时间后最终出现的
glossary.note: eventual result；区别于 possible 和表示可能性的词。
glossary.example: The eventual result was a shorter queue.
glossary.exampleZh: 最后的结果是队伍短了些。

externalEvidence.definition: expected to follow in the indefinite future from causes already operating

glossary.note: a taxing task/day；这里不是征税这个动词义。
glossary.example: It had been a taxing morning.

glossary.note: virtually impossible；此处不是线上或虚拟技术的意思。
glossary.example: Finishing everything by six was virtually impossible.
glossary.exampleZh: 六点前全部完成几乎不可能。

externalEvidence.definition: (of actions or states) slightly short of or not quite accomplished; all but
